bundle - gopro - hero13 black creator ed.description: Become the ultimate content creator with the GoPro HERO13 Black Creator Edition Camera Bundle, a comprehensive solution designed for vlogging, filmmaking, and live streaming. This all-in-one powerhouse is centered around the HERO13 Black, renowned for its superior 5.3K60 video quality and award-winning HyperSmooth 6.0 video stabilization, ensuring your footage remains crisp and steady even in the most dynamic environments.The Creator Edition includes a versatile battery grip that provides over 5 hours of 4K recording time per charge, featuring built-in controls for seamless camera operation during extended shoots. The bundle also boasts a directional microphone to minimize ambient noise, Bluetooth audio connectivity for wireless mic use, an LED light, and a Magnetic Latch Mount for effortless battery swaps. Transfer your footage with ease using wireless, wired, or SD card options.Expand your creative horizons with compatibility for HB-Series Lenses, allowing you to capture ultra-wide shots, professional-grade anamorphic footage, and more. The HERO13 Black Creator Edition is equipped with the Volta (Battery Grip/Tripod/Remote), Media Mod, and Light Mod, all integrated into a lightweight, portable design ideal for all-day use.Capture breathtaking 5.3K video with 91% more resolution than 4K and 665% more than 1080p, and extract stunning 24.7MP photos from your footage using the GoPro Quik app. Experience the slowest slo-mo ever with 13x speed reduction, and record 4x slo-mo clips in 5.3K resolution to unveil details invisible to the naked eye.HyperSmooth 6.0 sets the standard for in-camera stabilization, with AutoBoost ensuring the widest stabilized footage by adjusting based on speed and movement. The built-in 360-degree Horizon Lock keeps your shots level, even during full rotations, delivering professional-grade smoothness.The HERO13 Black Creator Edition's Enduro battery, combined with the Volta grip, offers 6800mAh of power, supporting over 5 hours of 4K or 4.5 hours of 5.3K30 recording. Enhanced cold weather performance ensures reliability in winter conditions.Control your camera with one hand using integrated grip buttons, or detach the camera for remote operation up to 98ft (30m) away. The Media Mod expands your setup with a 3.5mm mic port, HDMI-out, and two cold-shoe mounts for additional accessories.Illuminate your adventures with the Light Mod, offering four brightness levels up to 200 lumens, plus Overdrive and strobe modes. The Volta grip's built-in tripod and swivel mounting fingers provide flexibility for stationary and angled shots.Record in HLG-HDR for professional-grade 5.3K and 4K video, and choose from widescreen, vertical, or full-frame capture options with the powerful 1/1.9" image sensor. Enjoy enhanced color depth with 10-bit color and Log encoding, and sync multiple GoPros with Timecode Sync for streamlined editing.Capture 27MP photos and extract 24.7MP frame grabs from your videos. Bluetooth audio connectivity allows for wireless mic use and voice command recognition, while the Media Mod's directional mic enhances audio capture with wind suppression.QuikCapture lets you start recording instantly with a single button press, and GPS Performance Stickers add dynamic telemetry data overlays to your videos. Frame your shots perfectly with front and rear LCD screens, and customize your settings with personalized presets for every activity.Elevate your content creation with the GoPro HERO13 Black Creator Edition Camera Bundle, the ultimate tool for capturing your story with unparalleled quality and versatility.
